subject.title: fix(infra): normalize legacy not-requested task delivery status

question: Should the complete fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/103168 be carried by this PR or by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103173?
rationale: This PR is incomplete for the observed persisted state, while the overlapping PR contains the missing database repair; maintainers must select one branch to avoid duplicate migration paths.

options.title: Adopt the broader candidate
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103173 if its exact-head patch and real behavior proof satisfy the merge gate, then close this partial branch.

options.title: Complete this branch
options.body: Port the existing-database repair and focused coverage into this PR, add real recovery proof, and close the competing branch.

recommendation.title: Adopt the broader candidate
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103173 if its exact-head patch and real behavior proof satisfy the merge gate, then close this partial branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged refactor introduced the shared task-state architecture and migration boundary at the center of this choice.
